paragraphs: Neuronetics, Inc. (the "Company" or "Neuronetics" or the "Registrant") believes that mental health is as important as physical health. As a global leader in neuroscience, the Company is delivering more treatment options to patients and healthcare providers by offering exceptional in-office treatments that produce extraordinary results. The Company's first commercial product, the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System, is a non-invasive and non-systemic office-based treatment that uses transcranial magnetic stimulation ("TMS"), to create a pulsed, magnetic resonance imaging ("MRI")-strength magnetic field that induces electrical currents designed to stimulate specific areas of the brain associated with mood. The system is cleared by the United States ("U.S.") Food and Drug Administration (the "FDA") to treat adult patients with major depressive disorder ("MDD") who have failed to achieve satisfactory improvement from prior antidepressant medication in the current MDD episode. It is also cleared by the FDA as an adjunct for adults with obsessive-compulsive disorder ("OCD") and for adolescent patients aged 15-21 with MDD. It is also cleared by the FDA to decrease anxiety symptoms in adult patients with MDD that may exhibit comorbid anxiety symptoms (anxious depression). In addition to selling the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System and associated treatment sessions to customers, we operate Greenbrook treatment centers ("Treatment Centers") across the U.S., offering NeuroStar Advanced Therapy. Greenbrook, a leading provider of mental healthcare services, is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. The NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System is safe, clinically effective, reproducible and precise and we believe is supported by the largest clinical data set of any competing TMS system. Treatment Centers also obtain SPRAVATO® to treat adults with treatment-resistant depression or depressive symptoms in adults suffering from MDD with acute suicidal ideation or behavior. We believe we are the market leader in TMS therapy based on the estimated 237,574 global patients treated with over 8.5 million of our treatment sessions through December 31, 2025. We generated revenues of $149.2 million for the year ended December 31, 2025.

MDD is a mood disorder characterized by the presence of one or both of two major diagnostic criteria: a depressed mood or loss of interest in pleasure that continues for at least two weeks. The presence of at least one of these diagnostic symptoms must be accompanied by several of the following additional symptoms: sleep disturbance, changes in appetite, sexual dysfunction, anxiety, fatigue, difficulty concentrating and suicidal thinking. MDD is a recurrent disease and follows a fluctuating course over an individual's lifetime. It can be characterized by periods of remission and relapse.

The World Health Organization (the "WHO") ranks MDD as the largest contributor to global disability and a major contributor to suicide worldwide. According to a study published in the Journal of PharmacoEconomics in 2021, the economic burden of MDD was estimated to be $326.2 billion, an increase of 37.9% relative to 2010. The WHO estimates indicate the proportion of the global population with depression to be 4.4% and that there are over 300 million people in the world living with depression. Based on U.S. Census Bureau data and a study published in the Journal of the American Medical Association, we estimate that approximately 21 million people between the ages of 22 and 70 years in the United States suffer from MDD annually, of whom an estimated 13.9 million, based on data from the Journal of the American Medical Association, are being treated by a psychiatrist. We estimate, based on data from the Sequenced Treatment Alternatives to Relieve Depression study (the "STAR*D Study") that approximately 6.4 million of these patients have failed to achieve remission of their MDD from their prior antidepressant medication therapy and that approximately 3.8 million of those patients have commercial insurance or federal healthcare programs coverage for NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System. As a result, based on our expected revenues for a standard course of treatment, we believe our total annual addressable market opportunity for treatment sessions in the United States is approximately $8.9 billion.

Initial treatment options for MDD often consist of antidepressant medication prescribed by a primary care physician. Although a variety of antidepressant medications are available, drug therapy has at least two

primary limitations: limited effectiveness and treatment-emergent side effects. These limitations were demonstrated in the STAR*D Study, a large clinical trial funded by the U.S. National Institute of Mental Health that enrolled more than 4,000 adult MDD patients at 41 clinical sites to examine the outcomes to a sequenced series of antidepressant medication attempts that mimicked best practices. In the STAR*D Study, only approximately 28% and 21% of patients achieved remission in their first and second medication attempts, respectively. Many patients taking antidepressant medications experience intolerable or troubling side effects that contribute to a delay or failure in attaining an effective or optimal antidepressant dose, poor patient treatment adherence or discontinuation of treatment therapy. The likelihood of achieving remission is limited and declines with each successive medication attempt.

TMS is considered an appropriate therapy for the treatment of MDD patients who have failed to achieve satisfactory improvement from at least one prior antidepressant medication. TMS is typically performed as an office-based procedure using a capital equipment system designed to deliver the magnetic pulses necessary to stimulate the areas of the brain associated with mood. A course of treatment typically requires treatment sessions five times per week for up to six weeks and can last from as short as three to as long as forty-five minutes per session. We believe the effectiveness of TMS depends on the healthcare provider's ability to deliver a precise amount of magnetic pulses to a specific area of the brain in a manner that can be consistently repeated during each treatment session.

We designed the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System as a non-invasive therapeutic alternative to treat patients who suffer from MDD and to address many of the key limitations of existing treatment options. We believe our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System provides our provider customers and their patients with several benefits, including clinically demonstrated response and remission with durable results, a demonstrated safety profile with limited treatment-emergent side effects and high patient adherence. Additionally, NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System was designed to provide a precise and reproducible office-based therapy that is efficient and convenient. Our therapy is delivered without general anesthesia or sedation, enabling the patient to drive and resume normal activities immediately following each treatment session. We couple our product's clinical benefits with practice development resources, on-site clinical training and reimbursement and service support to help our provider customers develop a successful NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System practice. We also provide cloud-based practice management solutions that enhance convenience for both providers and patients. Based on our commercial data, we believe providers can recoup their initial capital investment in our system by providing a standard course of treatment to approximately 12 patients, assuming these patients receive reimbursement from federal healthcare programs or commercial insurance at rates that are similar to what our customers have observed for existing and prior patients. We believe psychiatrists can generate approximately $9,000 of average revenue per commercially insured patient for a standard course of treatment, which may provide meaningful incremental income to their practices. We believe that the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System coupled with these advantages offer significant improvement over competing TMS systems, which lack the ability to reproduce consistent treatments, significant clinical data from randomized outcome trials, practice development resources, and a cloud-based practice management system.

The safety, effectiveness and durability of NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System is supported by a large clinical data set published in 31 articles in peer-reviewed medical journals, including from 15 clinical studies that have collectively enrolled more than 1,000 adult patients suffering from MDD. Dunner, et. al. published results of a naturalistic, prospective, observational trial conducted at 42 U.S. clinical sites in 257 patients who had tried and failed to receive relief from one or more medication trials in their current MDD episode who were treated with an acute course of NeuroStar therapy. Response and remission rates at 12 months were 68% and 45% respectively as measured by Clinical Global Impression-Severity ("CGI-S").

Our growth strategy includes expanding our commercialization efforts in the United States, expanding international opportunities and pursuing pipeline development of our therapy for additional indications. Outside the United States, our products have received marketing authorizations in the European Union and Japan. Our international commercial focus is on Japan, which has the third largest healthcare spend globally.
We are also evaluating the use of enhancements to our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System to treat additional indications.
We currently sell our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System and recurring treatment sessions in the United States with the collaborative support of our 658 employees as of December 31, 2025.

We generate NeuroStar revenues from clinic revenue, capital sales of our systems, sales of our recurring treatment sessions, service and repair and extended warranty contracts. We derive the majority of our revenues from clinic and recurring treatment sessions.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, we generated revenues of $149.2 million and had a net loss of $39.1 million. Our revenues increased 99% during the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the year ended December 31, 2024.

For the year ended December 31, 2025, our U.S. revenues were $146.0 million, compared to $72.5 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, which represented an increase of 101% compared to the prior period. Clinic revenues represented 59% of our U.S. revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to 6% of our U.S. revenues in the prior year. Revenue from treatment sessions represented 30% of our U.S. revenues for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to 70% in the prior year.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
We have incurred losses in the past and may be unable to achieve or sustain profitability in the future.
We rely on the sale of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System and treatment sessions to generate revenues.
If we are unable to adequately train providers on the safe and appropriate use of our products and services, we may be unable to achieve our expected growth.
Customers and their patients may be slow to adopt and use TMS therapies.
Our success depends upon patient satisfaction with the effectiveness of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System.
We operate in a very competitive environment and if we are unable to compete successfully against our existing or potential competitors, our sales and operating results may be negatively affected.
We may face difficulties encountered by companies in new and evolving markets.

The loss of any member of our senior management or our inability to attract and retain highly skilled executives, salespeople, product development and other personnel could negatively impact our business.
We may be unable to achieve or manage our anticipated growth effectively, which could make it difficult to execute our business strategy.

We rely on a network of third-party distributors to market and distribute our products internationally, and if we are unable to maintain and expand this network, we may be unable to generate anticipated sales.
We face risks associated with our international business.
Our employees, consultants, distributors and other commercial partners may engage in misconduct or other improper activities, including non-compliance with regulatory standards and requirements.
If product liability lawsuits are brought against us, our business may be harmed, and we may be required to pay damages that exceed our insurance coverage.
Our insurance policies protect us only from some business risks, which will leave us exposed to significant uninsured liabilities.
We bear the risk of warranty claims on our products.
We could be negatively impacted by violations of applicable anti-corruption laws or violations of our internal policies designed to ensure ethical business practices.
If we experience significant disruptions in our information technology systems, our business may be adversely affected.

Performance issues, service interruptions or price increases by our shipping carriers could adversely affect our business and harm our reputation and ability to provide our services on a timely basis.
Security and privacy breaches may expose us to liability and harm our reputation and business.
Employment litigation and unfavorable publicity could negatively affect our future business.
Our effective tax rate may fluctuate, and we may incur obligations in tax jurisdictions in excess of accrued amounts.
Our operations are vulnerable to interruption or loss due to natural or other disasters, power loss, strikes and other events beyond our control.
paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below and the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K before deciding whether to invest in our common stock. The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could harm our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects. As a result, the market price of our common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment.

We have incurred net losses since inception, including net losses of $39.1 million and $43.7 million for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively. As a result of ongoing losses, as of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $458.8 million. We expect to continue to incur significant integration, sales and marketing, product development, regulatory and other expenses as we continue to expand our marketing efforts to increase adoption of our products and services and expand existing relationships with our customers, to obtain regulatory clearances or approvals for our products in additional countries and for additional indications, integrate the Greenbrook business, and to develop new products or add new features to our existing products. The net losses we incur may fluctuate significantly from quarter to quarter. We will need to generate significant additional revenues to achieve and sustain profitability, and even if we achieve profitability, we cannot be sure that we will remain profitable for any
substantial period of time. Our failure to achieve or maintain profitability could negatively impact the value of our common stock.

We rely, in part, on the sale of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System and treatment sessions to generate revenues, and we expect to generate a substantial portion of our revenues in the foreseeable future from sales of these and any related products and services. Because the market for TMS therapy is still developing and contains a limited number of market participants, sales of our products could be negatively impacted by unfavorable market reactions to our or other TMS devices. If the use of our or other TMS therapies results in serious adverse events, or such products malfunction or are misused, patients and providers may attribute such negative events to TMS therapy generally, which may adversely affect market adoption of our products and services. Additionally, if patients undergoing treatment with a NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System perceive the benefits to be inadequate or adverse events too numerous or severe compared to the relevant rates of alternative TMS therapies or pharmaceutical options, it will be difficult to demonstrate the value of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System to patients and providers. As a result, demand for and the use of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System may decline or may not increase at the pace or to the levels we expect.
Our business and ability to meet obligations to our customers may be disrupted and our results of operations, financial condition, cash flows and liquidity
may be adversely affected by a global pandemic or epidemic diseases.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our audited consolidated financial statements and related notes thereto and other financial information included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. In addition to historical financial information, some of the information contained in the following discussion and analysis contains forward-looking statements that involve risks, uncertainties and assumptions. You should review the Risk Factors section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for a discussion of important factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from the results described in or implied by the forward-looking statements contained in the following discussion and analysis.

As a global leader in neuroscience, we are delivering more treatment options to patients and healthcare providers by offering exceptional in-office treatments that produce extraordinary results. Our first commercial product, the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System, is a non-invasive and non-systemic office-based treatment that uses TMS to create a pulsed, MRI-strength magnetic field that induces electrical currents designed to stimulate specific areas of the brain associated with mood. The system is cleared by the FDA to treat adult patients with MDD that have failed to achieve satisfactory improvement from prior antidepressant medication in the current MDD episode. It is also cleared by the FDA as an adjunct for adults with OCD and for adolescent patients aged 15-21 with MDD. It is also cleared by the FDA to decrease anxiety symptoms in adult patients with MDD that may exhibit comorbid anxiety symptoms (anxious depression). In addition to selling the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System and associated treatment sessions to customers, we operate Greenbrook Treatment Centers across the U.S., offering NeuroStar Advanced Therapy. Greenbrook, a leading provider of mental healthcare services, is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. We believe we are the market leader in TMS therapy based on the estimated 237,574 global patients treated with over 8.5 million of our treatment sessions through December 31, 2025. We generated revenues of $149.2 million and $74.9 million for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

Effective as of December 9, 2024, Neuronetics and Greenbrook completed the Arrangement. Each Greenbrook Share outstanding immediately prior to the effective time of the Arrangement was exchanged for Neuronetics Shares at the Exchange Ratio upon closing of the Arrangement. We continue to operate as Neuronetics, Inc., and the Neuronetics Shares continue to trade on the NASDAQ Global Market under the ticker "STIM".

We designed the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System as a non-invasive therapeutic alternative to treat patients who suffer from MDD and to address many of the key limitations of existing treatment options. Additionally through our acquisition of Greenbrook, we now derive revenue directly from our Treatment Centers, by providing TMS therapy and SPRAVATO for MDD and other mental health disorders. We derive the majority of our revenues from clinic revenue and treatment sessions.

We currently operate under in two segments: Medicial device and Clinic services. We generate revenues from clinic operations, initial capital sales of our systems, sales of our recurring treatment sessions and from service and repair and extended warranty contracts.

For the year ended December 31, 2025 revenues from sales of our clinic revenue, treatment sessions and NeuroStar Advanced Therapy Systems represented 59%, 30% and 10% of our U.S. revenues, respectively. For the year ended December 31, 2024, revenues from sales of our clinic, treatment sessions and NeuroStar Advanced Therapy Systems represented 6%, 70% and 21% of our U.S. revenues, respectively.

Clinic revenue consists of revenue attributable to the performance of treatments to patients in 15 states in the U.S. In circumstances where the net patient fees have not yet been received, the amount of revenue recognized is estimated based on an expected value approach. Due to the nature of the industry and complexity of our clinic revenue arrangements, where price lists are subject to the discretion of payors, variable consideration exists that may result in price concessions and constraints to the transaction price for the services rendered.
Clinic revenue reimbursements are derived from third-party payors including federal and state agencies (under the Medicare programs), managed care health plans and commercial insurance companies.

We currently sell our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System and recurring treatment sessions in the U.S. through our sales and customer support team. Our sales force targets an estimated 53,000 psychiatrists across 26,000 practices. We expect to continue to expand our direct sales and customer support team to further penetrate the market by demonstrating the benefits of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System to providers and their MDD patients. Some of our customers have purchased or may purchase more than one NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System. Based on our commercial data, we believe providers can recoup their initial capital investment in our system by providing a standard course of treatment to approximately 12 patients. We believe psychiatrists can generate approximately $9,000 of average revenue per patient for a standard course of treatment, which may provide meaningful incremental income to their practices. We have a diverse customer base in the U.S. Patients are reimbursed by federal healthcare programs and the vast majority of commercial payors in the U.S. for treatment sessions utilizing our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System. For the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, one customer Greenbrook, accounted for 12% and 15%, respectively, of the Company's revenue. Following the acquisition of Greenbrook, there are no significant customers.

We market our products in a few select markets outside the United States through independent distributors. International revenues represented 2% and 3% of our total revenues for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively. In October 2017, we entered into an exclusive distribution agreement, for the distribution of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy Systems and treatment sessions to customers who will treat patients with MDD in Japan. We received regulatory approval for our system in Japan in September 2017. We obtained reimbursement coverage for NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System in Japan, which went into effect on June 1, 2019 and covers patients who are treated in the largest inpatient and outpatient psychiatric facilities in Japan. We expect our international revenues to decrease as a percentage of our total revenue.

Our research and development efforts are focused on hardware and software product developments and enhancements of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System and clinical development relating to additional indications. We outsource the manufacture of components of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy Systems that are produced to our specifications, and individual components are either shipped directly from our third-party contract manufacturers to our customers or consolidated into pallets at our Malvern, Pennsylvania facility prior to shipment. Final installation of these systems occurs at the customer site.

Our total revenues increased by $74.3 million, or 99%, from $74.9 million for the year ended December 31, 2024 to $149.2 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, due to the inclusion of revenues from our Greenbrook acquisition. For the year ended December 31, 2025, our U.S. revenues were $146.0 million,
compared to $72.5 million for the year ended December 31, 2024, which represented an increase of 101% year over year. As of December 31, 2025, we had an accumulated deficit of $458.8 million.

We have generated revenues primarily from the sale of our NeuroStar Advanced Therapy Systems and related sales and rentals of the NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System, clinic revenue and the recurring revenues from our sale of treatment sessions in the U.S.

paragraphs: Neuronetics, Inc. (the "Company" or "Neuronetics" or the "Registrant") 認為心理健康與身體健康一樣重要。作為全球神經科學領域的領導者，本公司透過提供卓越的診斷治療方案，為患者與醫療專業人員提供更多的治療選擇，並產生卓越的治療成果。本公司首個商業產品，NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System，是一種非侵入性且非系統性的診斷治療方案，利用經顱磁刺激 ("TMS") 產生脈衝式、磁共振成像 ("MRI") 級強度的磁場，以誘導電流刺激與情緒相關的大腦特定區域。該系統已獲得美國 ("U.S.") 食品藥物管理局 (the "FDA") 批准，用於治療在當前重度憂鬱症 ("MDD") 發作中未能從先前抗憂鬱藥物獲得滿意改善的成人患者。該系統也已獲得 FDA 批准，作為治療患有強迫症 ("OCD") 的成人及 15 至 21 歲患有 MDD 的青少年患者的輔助治療。該系統也已獲得 FDA 批准，用於減少患有 MDD 的成人患者伴隨焦慮症狀 (焦慮性憂鬱) 的焦慮症狀。除了向客戶銷售 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 及相關治療課程外，本公司於美國運營 Greenbrook 治療中心 ("Treatment Centers")，提供 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy。Greenbrook 是一家領先的心理健康服務供應商，為本公司百分之百擁有之子公司。NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 是安全、臨牀有效、可重複且精準的治療方案，本公司認為其擁有任何競爭 TMS 系統中最大的臨牀數據集。Treatment Centers 也取得 SPRAVATO® 用於治療患有治療抵抗性憂鬱症或伴隨 MDD 的成人患者出現急性自殺意念或行為的憂鬱症狀。本公司認為，根據截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的預估數據，我們是 TMS 治療的市場領導者，全球已治療 237,574 名患者，並進行超過 8.5 百萬次治療課程。本公司在 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年產生收入 149.2 百萬美元。
MDD 是一種情緒障礙，特徵為持續至少兩週的抑鬱情緒或對樂趣失去興趣。至少出現上述兩項診斷症狀之一，必須伴隨以下多項附加症狀：睡眠障礙、飲食習慣改變、性功能障礙、焦慮、疲勞、難以專注及自殺想法。MDD 是一種反覆發作的疾病，會在個人一生中呈現波動的病程。它可以被描述為有緩解期與復發期。

世界衛生組織 (the "WHO") 將 MDD 評估為對全球失能的最大貢獻者，也是全球自殺的主要貢獻者。根據 2021 年發表於《藥物經濟學雜誌》的研究，MDD 的經濟負擔估計為 326.2 十億美元，相較於 2010 年增加了 37.9%。世界衛生組織的估計顯示，全球人口中患有抑鬱症的比例為 4.4%，全球有超過 3 億人正在與抑鬱症共存。根據美國人口普查局數據及發表於《美國醫學會雜誌》的研究，我們估計美國 22 至 70 歲之間每年約有 2100 萬人患有 MDD，其中根據《美國醫學會雜誌》的數據，約有 1390 萬人正在接受精神科醫師的治療。根據《治療替代以緩解抑鬱症研究》(the "STAR*D Study") 的數據，我們估計這些患者中約有 640 萬人未能從先前的抗抑鬱藥物治療中達到 MDD 的緩解，而其中約有 380 萬人擁有商業保險或聯邦醫療保險計劃的覆蓋，可使用 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System。因此，根據我們預期的標準治療課程收入，我們認為美國治療課程的總年潛在市場規模約為 89 億美元。
MDD 的初始治療選擇通常包括由一般科醫師處方的抗抑鬱藥物。雖然有許多種抗抑鬱藥物可供選擇，但藥物治療至少有兩個

主要限制：有限的治療效果和治療期間的副作用。這些限制在 STAR*D 研究中有所體現，STAR*D 研究是由美國國家精神衛生研究所資助的大型臨牀試驗，招募了超過 4,000 名 MDD 成人患者，在 41 個臨牀試點中研究一系列抗抑鬱藥物試驗的結果，以模擬最佳實踐。在 STAR*D 研究中，只有約 28% 和 21% 的患者在第一次和第二次藥物試驗中達到緩解。許多服用抗抑鬱藥物的患者會經歷無法忍受或令人困擾的副作用，這會導致無法達到有效的或最佳的抗抑鬱藥物劑量、患者治療依從性差或中止治療。達到緩解的機率有限，且隨每一次後續的藥物試驗而下降。
TMS 被認為是治療未能從至少一種先前抗抑鬱藥物獲得滿意改善的 MDD 患者適當的治療方式。TMS 通常作為診斷治療程序在診所內進行，使用專用設備系統來提供必要的磁脈衝，以刺激與情緒相關的大腦區域。治療課程通常需要每週五次治療，持續最多六週，每次治療時間可短至三到長至四十五分鐘。我們認為 TMS 的有效性取決於醫療專業人員能否在每次治療中以一致的方式，將正確數量的磁脈衝傳送到特定的大腦區域。

我們設計了 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 作為一種非侵入性治療方案，用於治療患有 MDD 的患者，並解決現有治療選擇的許多關鍵限制。我們相信，NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 為我們的醫療專業人員客戶及其患者提供了多種優點，包括臨牀證實的反應和緩解，具有持久的治療效果，具備安全的治療資料，副作用有限，以及高患者依從性。此外，NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 被設計為提供精確且可重複的診所內治療，具有效率和便利性。我們的治療方式不需要全身麻醉或鎮靜，使患者在每次治療後可以立即駕駛並恢復正常活動。我們將產品的臨牀優勢與實踐發展資源、現場臨牀培訓及報銷與服務支持結合，協助我們的醫療專業人員客戶建立成功的 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 運作。我們也提供基於雲端的實踐管理解決方案，提高對醫療專業人員和患者的便利性。根據我們的商業數據，我們相信醫療專業人員客戶可以透過為約 12 名患者提供標準治療課程，回收其初始資本投資，假設這些患者從聯邦醫療保險計劃或商業保險獲得報銷，報銷率與我們客戶觀察到的現有和過去患者相似。我們相信精神科醫師可以為每位商業保險患者提供標準治療課程的平均收入約為 9,000 美元，這可能為其診所帶來有意義的額外收入。我們相信，NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 與這些優勢結合，相比競爭的 TMS 系統，提供了顯著的改進，這些競爭系統缺乏重複一致治療的能力、來自隨機結果試驗的重大臨牀數據、實踐發展資源，以及基於雲端的實踐管理系統。

NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 的安全性、有效性及持久性由一個大型臨牀數據集支持，該數據集發表於 31 篇經過同行評審的醫學期刊中，包括來自 15 個臨牀研究的結果，這些研究 collectively 運動了超過 1,000 名患有 MDD 的成人患者。Dunner 等人發表了一項自然觀察性試驗的結果，該試驗在 42 個美國臨牀試點進行，有 257 名患者曾嘗試並未能從一或多種藥物試驗中獲得緩解，這些患者在當前 MDD 發作中接受了急性期的 NeuroStar 治療。12 個月的反應率和緩解率分別為 68% 和 45%，以臨牀全球評估嚴重度 ("CGI-S") 來衡量。
本公司成長策略包括擴大在美國的商業化努力、拓展國際機會以及追蹤我們療法的開發管道以用於其他適應症。除了美國之外，我們的產品已獲得歐盟與日本的市場許可。我們的國際商業重點為日本，日本為全球第三大醫療支出國家。
我們同時也在評估利用我們NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System的升級功能，用以治療其他適應症。
截至2025年12月31日，我們在美國銷售NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System與重複治療課程，並有658名員工協同支持。
我們的NeuroStar收入來自診所收入、系統資本銷售、重複治療課程銷售、服務與維修以及延長保固合約。我們的收入主要來自診所與重複治療課程。
截至2025年12月31日，我們產生了149.2 百萬美元收入，並產生了39.1 百萬美元淨虧損。截至2025年12月31日，我們的收入較2024年12月31日的收入成長99%。
截至2025年12月31日，我們的美國收入為146.0 百萬美元，較2024年12月31日的72.5 百萬美元成長101%。診所收入佔我們2025年12月31日美國收入的59%，較前一年的6%有所成長。治療課程收入佔我們2025年12月31日美國收入的30%，較前一年的70%有所下降。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與我們經審計之合併財務報表及其相關附註，以及本年度10-K申報表其他處所載之其他財務資訊一併閱讀。除歷史財務資訊外，部分下列討論與分析中所載資訊為展望性陳述，涉及風險、不確定性與假設。請審閱本年度10-K申報表之風險因素部分，以瞭解可能導致我們實際結果與下列討論與分析中所述或暗示之展望性陳述有重大差異的重要因素。
自2024年12月9日起，Neuronetics與Greenbrook完成交易。於交易生效時，每張Greenbrook股權均按交易完成時之交換比率換為Neuronetics股權。我們繼續以Neuronetics, Inc.之名運營，Neuronetics股權繼續於NASDAQ Global Market交易，代碼為"STIM"。
我們設計NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System作為一種非侵入性治療替代方案，用以治療患有憂鬱症之患者，並解決現有治療選擇之許多關鍵限制。此外，透過我們收購Greenbrook，我們現已能透過治療中心直接產生收入，提供TMS治療及SPRAVATO用於憂鬱症及其他心理健康疾病。我們絕大多數收入來自診所收入及治療課程。
我們目前運營於兩個應報告分部：醫療器材與診所服務。我們之收入來自診所運營、我們系統之初始資本銷售、治療課程之銷售，以及服務與維修及延長保固合約。
截至2025年12月31日財年，我們之診所收入、治療課程及NeuroStar Advanced Therapy Systems銷售收入分別佔我們美國收入之59%、30%及10%。截至2024年12月31日財年，我們之診所、治療課程及NeuroStar Advanced Therapy Systems銷售收入分別佔我們美國收入之6%、70%及21%。
診所收入為提供美國15個州之患者治療所產生之收入。在尚未收到淨患者費用之情況下，收入之認列係根據預期價值法進行估算。由於產業性質及診所收入安排之複雜性，價格清單可能由付款方自行決定，因此存在變動對價，可能導致價格讓利及交易價格之限制。
診所收入之補償來自第三方付款方，包括聯邦及州政府機構（根據醫療保險計畫）、管理式醫療計畫及商業保險公司。

本公司目前透過銷售及客戶支援團隊，在美國銷售 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 及定期治療課程。我們的銷售團隊目標為約 53,000 名精神科醫師，分佈於 26,000 家診所。我們預期會持續擴充直接銷售及客戶支援團隊，以進一步打入市場，並向提供者及其 MDD 患者說明 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 的效益。部分客戶已購買或可能購買超過一個 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System。根據我們的商業資料，我們相信提供者透過提供標準治療課程給約 12 名患者，即可回收其在本系統的初始資本投資。我們相信精神科醫師透過標準治療課程可為每位患者產生約 9,000 美元的平均營業收入，這可能為其診所帶來有意義的額外收入。我們在美國擁有多元化的客戶羣。患者可透過美國聯邦醫療衛生計畫及美國大多數商業保險機構，獲得使用 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 進行治療課程的補償。截至 2024 年 12 月 31 日及 2023 年 12 月 31 日，客戶 Greenbrook 分別佔本公司營業收入的 12% 及 15%。於收購 Greenbrook 之後，本公司沒有重大客戶。

我們透過獨立經銷商，在美國以外的幾個特定市場行銷我們的產品。國際收入在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日的年度中，分別佔我們總收入的 2% 及 3%。2017 年 10 月，我們與日本的客戶簽訂獨家經銷協議，用以經銷我們的 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 及治療課程，供治療患有 MDD 的患者。我們在 2017 年 9 月獲得日本對本系統的監管批准。我們在 2019 年 6 月 1 日取得日本對 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 的補償覆蓋，適用於在日本最大住院及門診精神科機構接受治療的患者。我們預期國際收入將佔總收入的百分比下降。

我們的研究與開發工作著重於硬體及軟體產品的開發與增強，以及 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 的臨牀開發，與其他適應症相關。我們委外製造符合我們規格的 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 的零組件，這些零組件或是直接由第三方製造商運送到客戶，或是先在賓夕法尼亞州馬爾文 (Malvern) 工廠集結成貨架再運送。這些系統的最終安裝則在客戶現場進行。
我們的總收入較 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度的 74.9 百萬美元增加 74.3 百萬美元，或成長 99%，達到 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度的 149.2 百萬美元，原因是包含 Greenbrook 收購後的收入。2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，我們的美國收入為 146.0 百萬美元，
相較於 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度的 72.5 百萬美元，成長 101% 年增年減。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司累計虧損為 458.8 百萬美元。
我們的收入主要來自銷售 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System，以及相關的銷售與租賃收入、診所收入，以及美國銷售治療課程的持續性收入。

headings: 與我們業務及產業相關之風險
我們過去曾產生虧損，未來可能無法實現或維持盈利。
我們依賴NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System產品及治療課程之銷售來產生收入。
若我們無法對提供者進行適當且安全使用我們產品及服務之訓練，我們可能無法實現預期之成長。
客戶及其患者可能對TMS療法之採用與使用速度較慢。
我們之成功取決於患者對NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System產品之療效滿意度。
我們處於極其競爭之環境，若我們無法成功與現有或潛在競爭對手競爭，我們之銷售及營運結果可能受到負面影響。
我們可能面臨新興且發展中市場公司所遭遇之困難。
本公司高階管理階層任何成員之流失或無法吸引並留住具高技能之營運主管、業務人員、產品開發及其他人員，可能對本公司業務造成負面影響。
本公司可能無法有效達成或管理預期之成長，這可能使執行本公司營運策略變得困難。
本公司依賴第三方經銷商網路於國際市場行銷與銷售產品，若本公司無法維持並擴展此網路，可能無法達成預期之銷售額。
本公司面臨與國際業務相關之風險。
本公司員工、顧問、經銷商及其他商業合作夥伴可能涉及不當行為或其他違規活動，包括未符合監管標準與要求。
若對本公司提起產品責任訴訟，本公司業務可能受損，且本公司可能需支付超過保險賠償範圍之賠償金額。
本公司保險政策僅能對部分營運風險提供保障，這將使本公司面臨重大未投保之財務負擔。
本公司承擔產品保固聲請之風險。
本公司可能因違反適用之反貪污法規或違反本公司為確保合規商業行為所制定之內部政策而受到負面影響。
若本公司資訊科技系統遭遇重大中斷，可能對本公司營運造成不利影響。
本公司委外運輸夥伴之性能問題、服務中斷或價格上漲，可能對本公司營運造成不利影響，並損害本公司聲譽及時程上提供服務之能力。
安全與隱私權違規事件可能使本公司面臨法律責任，並損害本公司聲譽與營運。
勞動爭議及不利之公共關係可能對本公司未來營運造成負面影響。
本公司有效稅率可能波動，且本公司可能於稅務管轄區域產生超過預估金額之義務。
本公司營運可能因天然災害或其他災難、電力中斷、罷工及其他超出本公司控制範圍之事件而中斷或遭受損失。
paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及高度風險。您應仔細考慮下列所描述的風險與不確定性，以及本年度報告表 10-K 其他資訊，再決定是否投資本公司普通股。上述任何事件或發展發生，都可能影響本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景。因此，本公司普通股市價可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。

自成立以來，本公司已產生淨虧損，包括 2025 年 12 月 31 日財務年度及 2024 年 12 月 31 日財務年度分別為 39.1 百萬美元及 43.7 百萬美元的淨虧損。由於持續虧損，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司累計虧損為 458.8 百萬美元。本公司預期會持續產生重大整合、銷售與行銷、產品開發、法規及其它費用，以持續擴大行銷努力，提高產品與服務的採用率，擴展與客戶的現有關係，取得產品在更多國家或更多適應症的法規核准或批准，整合 Greenbrook 事業，以及開發新產品或為現有產品增加新功能。本公司產生的淨虧損可能在每季之間大幅波動。本公司需要產生重大額外收入以達成並維持盈利，即使本公司達成盈利，我們無法確定能否在任何長時間內維持盈利。
本公司未能達成或維持盈利，可能對本公司普通股價值產生負面影響。

本公司部分營收來自 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 及治療課程的銷售，我們預期在可預見的未來，將有相當大一部分營收來自這些產品與服務及其相關產品與服務的銷售。由於 TMS 治療市場仍在發展中，市場參與者有限，產品銷售可能因對本公司或其他 TMS 裝置的市場反應不佳而受到負面影響。如果本公司或其他 TMS 治療的使用導致嚴重不良事件，或產品故障或被誤用，患者與醫療提供者可能將這些負面事件歸因於 TMS 治療整體，這可能會對本公司產品與服務的市場採用率產生負面影響。此外，如果接受 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 治療的患者認為治療效益不足，或不良事件過多或過於嚴重，與相關替代 TMS 治療或藥物選項的發生率相比，將難以向患者與醫療提供者說明本公司 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 的價值。因此，對本公司 NeuroStar Advanced Therapy System 的需求與使用可能減少，或可能無法以我們預期的速度或達到預期的層次增加。
本公司業務及履行對客戶義務的能力可能受到幹擾，本公司營運結果、財務狀況、現金流與流動性
可能因全球疫情或傳染病大流行而受到負面影響。
